_comment: Fully fixture-scripted (no real LLM call, no setup.sql) -- exercises load_skill's real dispatch path (docs/components/memory-slot.md, 'Resolved: load_skill'). A scripted response's tool_calls still dispatch for REAL (fixtures only script the model's own text/tool_calls, never the handler), so tools.load_skill's real handler runs and calls agent_brain.call_retain_tool('memory_load_skill', ...). agent-brain doesn't implement memory_load_skill yet, so this call is expected to fail cleanly today -- either AgentBrainNotConfiguredError (AGENT_BRAIN_RETAIN_BASE_URL unset) or AgentBrainCallError (configured, but the backend tool doesn't exist) -- and the turn should still complete normally afterward, the same as any other failed tool call ever does; that degrade-gracefully behavior is exactly what this scenario checks. Once agent-brain ships memory_load_skill for real, this scenario should gain a companion exercising the success path (tool_refs present, persisted into turn_retrieval, and a follow-up step calling one of them by name -- same shape as resolved-tool-dispatch.json) -- not written yet since there's nothing real to script against until that backend tool exists.
